agreement_source.embedded_signal: derived: the share of this row's own top-20 sealed TRAIN-exemplar recall whose frozen build-time task_target equals each boundary intent, self-excluded by the row's utterance identity and normalised to 1. Speech-keyed by construction -- the recall it summarises is the row's own sealed speech vector against the frozen pool -- and gold-free: the key is a released store property, never a label, transcript or future turn. Built model-free by scripts/build_slurp_intent_exemplar_agreement.py with zero model, server, encoder, embedder, scorer, network and GPU contacts; receipt beside the artifact.

what_the_train_exemplars_store_is: SLURP v2 base program module M1 / cell B1 (docs/superpowers/specs/2026-09-16-slurp-v2-base-program-design.md section 3-4; A2 decision docs/results/2026-09-17-slurp-a2-exemplar-headroom-audit-v1.md): the top-20 TRAIN construction-pool exemplars (excluding every utterance with a recording in TRAIN Fold A, Fold B or DEV-1000; 9,354-facet pool) recalled by cosine against this row's OWN sealed Fold A speech vector, ranked by saea-rank-wcos-prior-agree-v1 (identity on cosine: w_cos=1, w_prior=0, w_agree=0) and passed through saea-fuse-supplyfilter-v1 with m=c=top_l=20 -- twenty in, twenty out on every row, the same 'no coverage reshaping' discipline cell KU-S3 established. Each value renders as '<utterance> | <scenario>_<action> | type=filler; ...' (KB view annotated-exemplars, scripts/build_knowledge_snapshot.py). The decision is delivered to the SOLVER phase (the program's LAST phase) through the E6 acquire transition -- NOT the bootstrap seam intent-boundaries uses, because solver is not the first phase -- as typed content blocks (evidence_id/source_uri/knowledge_role='value', store-prefixed 'train-exemplars::...'); the Solver's instruction bytes are byte-identical to the unmodified anchor's. The composed acquire transition also carries the slot-contracts store's own candidate_supply.solver decision on the same wave; both compose into one PhaseSupply via rails.knowledge_stores._compose_supplies.
what_this_is: Cell E4-1 (owner decision 185): the core-native targeted re-listen as a shadow post-accept stage on the retained AGREE arm. THE BASE CHANGE (the only one besides the relisten block): policy phase-native-candidates-review-revise-v1 (ceiling 11) -> phase-native-candidates-review-revise-relisten-v1 (ceiling 17 = 11 + 2 x max_slots_per_row 3; the two program fragments differ only in program_id and max_contacts; the Solver stays uncited). THE RELISTEN BLOCK: native_episode.relisten {"blind_template_id": "slurp_relisten_blind_v1", "confirm_template_id": "slurp_relisten_confirm_v1", "delivery": "shadow", "max_slots_per_row": 3, "policy": "saea-obs-targeted-relisten-v1", "value_max_words": 8} -- a post-accept stage after the deliver normaliser: for up to 3 delivered entities per row, in delivery order, a BLIND contact (packet + decided intent + slot type, never the delivered value) and, when the blind value is canonically different, unheard or unparsed, a FORCED-CHOICE contact (delivered value vs the blind value or the unheard sentinel, order fixed by sha256(sample_id, slot type); the decided intent only, never Perception's candidates). SHADOW DELIVERY: the delivered answer is the AGREE form's own and is never mutated; the saea-relisten-v1 receipt is sealed per row and two shadow columns (relisten-replace-only, relisten-replace-drop-unheard) are rendered offline. The delivered path's request bytes are the AGREE arm's EXCEPT the two program-identity fields the switch moves (the program id inside quoted prior contact ids; remaining_model_contacts, +6) -- proven by scripts/flights/e4/e4_shadow_proof.py. Nothing else moves: roster (arm), geometry, session, role graph, max_revisions 1, the agreement term and its sealed table, every knowledge store and pin, every template, the deliver normaliser and the scorers are the AGREE arm's, byte for byte.
